request.system:
You answer a question about machines at work using ONLY the documents in the current folder: EU and
Italian law, guidance, manufacturers' manuals, a company's documents and a plant's records, one text file per
document. README.md lists them. Use your tools (Glob, Grep, Read) to find and read what you need; search in
English and in Italian, since the documents are in both languages.

Rules:
- Use only what the files say. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the files do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the files.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several things answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- When you have the answer, or are sure the files do not hold it, reply with JSON only, nothing before or after:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the document and the article, section or page",
   "sources": [{"file": "<file name>", "place": "<heading of the section>", "quote": "<the sentence relied on, copied>"}]}
request.question: Given that the company works in mining areas (extractive sector), for which positions among the fixed devices in the list (overhead travelling cranes and the gantry crane) is the verification yearly today?

response.text: {"kind": "set", "value": ["pos. 8 (gru a ponte scorrevole, DEMAG, 1985)", "pos. 9 (gru a ponte scorrevole, DEMAG, 1985)", "pos. 10 (gru a ponte scorrevole, GUTTER, 1988)", "pos. 11 (gru a ponte scorrevole, DEFRIES-TITANO, 1978)", "pos. 12 (gru a ponte scorrevole, PRIM, 1980)", "pos. 23 (gru a cavalletto, Pellegrini GCB 35 X, 1989)"], "text": "Under Allegato VII of D.Lgs. 81/08, fixed lifting appliances over 200 kg used in the extractive sector and built more than 10 years ago need an annual check; as of 2026 that covers overhead travelling cranes positions 8–12 and the gantry crane at position 23 in the IGEA plant list. Position 13 (overhead travelling crane, built 2017) is not older than 10 years, so its check is biennial, not yearly.", "sources": [{"file": "igea-equipment.md", "place": "p. 3, section 2.2 and Allegato A tables A2 and A5", "quote": "Qtà COMUNE Area mineraria Monteponi 19 Iglesias Campo Pisano Masua - Acquaresi 2 Gadoni Miniera Funtana Raminosa 2 Lula Miniera Sos Enattos 1 Furtei Miniera Furtei"}, {"file": "DLGSALLVII.md", "place": "Allegato VII, riga 15", "quote": "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg. non azionati a mano, di tipo fisso, con modalità di utilizzo riscontrabili in settori di impiego quali costruzioni, siderurgico, portuale, estrattivo e con anno di fabbricazione antecedente 10 anni | Verifiche annuali"}, {"file": "DLGSALLVII.md", "place": "Allegato VII, riga 16", "quote": "Apparecchi di sollevamento materiali con portata superiore a 200 Kg , non azionati a mano, di tipo fisso, con modalità di utilizzo riscontrabili in settori di impiego quali costruzioni, siderurgico, portuale, estrattivo e con anno di fabbricazione non antecedente 10 anni | Verifiche biennali"}]}
